Name: CP AT FS Minakie's Dressers
Author: catissocute
Description:
[size=4]A big thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Minakie?gameId=1303]Minakie[/url] for graciously allowing me to recode these adorable dressers.
If you love them, be sure to visit [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Minakie?gameId=1303]Minakie's page[/url] and show your support! ❤


Update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/648]Minakie's Dressers[/url] (CP + AT): These adorable dressers can now be used to open the outfit change menu.


This mod is built for the CP+AT framework I'm used to, and as such, includes over 1000 variants. To manage this:
[list]
[*]Navigate to: [code][CP][AT][FS]Minakie's Dressers\[CP][AT]Minakie's Dressers\ATMinakieDressersFS\textures\CuteDresser[/code]
[*]Delete any variant files you don't want.
[*]Renumber the remaining image files sequentially.
[*]Edit [code]texture.json[/code] and reduce the [code]"Variations"[/code] value from 1025 to match your new number of files.
[/list][/size]

Downloads.Description: It functions like the FS mirror if you have the Fashion Sense.
